text:
tara: Hey team — small ask, can someone take a quick look at PR #2178? It's a light change to the quantized batcher routing heuristics to cut unit cost for short-seq workloads. TL;DR: lower eviction threshold and prefer FP16 kernels for <512 tokens.

chris: Pinged — I'll take a look after stand. Main concern: does this increase cold-start latency or cause throughput regressions?

tara: Good Q. I ran quick benches on dev-cluster: p99 latency unchanged, median up ~5ms, throughput roughly the same. Token-cost down ~8% on our short-chat harness.

anna: Quick Q — what exactly is the config delta? Paste the snippet please.

tara: Sure — snippet below:
```diff
- evict_threshold_ms=60000
+ evict_threshold_ms=20000
batcher.prefer_fp16=true
routing.fallback_order=[fp16, int8, fp32]
```

liam: Heads up — I'm worried about FP16 accuracy on some older models (gpt-small variant). Can we gate by model tag rather than blanket enable?

tara: Good call. PR adds a model_tag allowlist: `quant.allow_fp16 = ["gpt-medium","redwood-v2"]`. Older models will fallback to int8.

chris: LGTM conceptually. Two asks before approval: (1) add a small unit test for fallback order, (2) run the perf job on staging-prod-1 (~20m). I can approve after both.

deploy-bot: perf-job started on staging-prod-1 (job id: 8852).

tara: Thanks — perf job kicked off. Adding the unit test now, will ping when green.

liam: If perf job passes, I can give one approval. @anna can you sanity-check the allowlist?

anna: Scanning now... quick nit: rename `allow_fp16` -> `fp16_whitelist` to match existing config schema. Otherwise looks fine :thumbsup:.

tara: Updated and pushed. CI green, perf job finished: token cost reduction ~7.9%, p99 latency +3ms. Ready for final review.

chris: Approved. Planning to merge during the next deploy window (today 17:00 PT) unless anyone objects.

liam: No objections.
